_doc: Original campaign variant, not the published Pathfinder tiefling package. No energy resistance, darkness spell or standard tiefling mechanics are implied. Traits list the two authored abilities; checks and durations are implemented in this campaign’s dialogues and map triggers.

oath_tiefling.name: Succubus-descended Tiefling (campaign)
traits: Original campaign ancestry: +2 Dex, +2 Cha, -2 Wis
Succubus Spittle (permanent innate ability): contact-based Charisma check in marked NPC dialogue; temporary openness, not truth or obedience. One attempt per NPC scene.

Invisible Pheromone Cloud: once per long rest, Charisma check at marked guard approaches; ten exploration tile entries. Living eligible humanoids only; undead, trolls and other unlisted creatures are immune.
oath_tiefling.desc: A mortal with succubus ancestry. This campaign-specific lineage and its powers are original additions, not standard Pathfinder racial rules.
